title: Instagram Carousel Designer / Photo Curator
description:
We are a husband-and-wife wedding photography and videography team looking for a creative designer to help us showcase our work beautifully on Instagram.



We photograph weddings in a candid, documentary-inspired style, and we are looking for someone with a strong eye for photography, storytelling, composition, and editorial design.



### What You'll Be Doing



For each post, we will provide you with access to a completed wedding gallery containing the images from the wedding.



Your job will be to:



- Review the wedding gallery and select the strongest images.

- Choose photographs that showcase both the couple's story and the quality of our photography.

- Create beautiful Instagram carousel posts that feel intentional and artistic.

- Arrange the photographs in a way that tells a story as someone swipes through the carousel.

- Create a cohesive mix of portraits, candid moments, details, wide shots, emotional moments, reception images, etc.

- Design the carousel in **Canva or Adobe InDesign**.

- Occasionally use creative layouts with multiple photographs, white space, crops, or editorial-style spreads when appropriate.

- Keep the overall look elevated, timeless, clean, and consistent with our brand.



We do **not** want every carousel to look exactly the same or feel like it came from a generic template. We want someone who can look at each wedding individually and d
 how to tell that particular story.



### The Style We're Looking For



Think:



**Editorial + documentary + timeless + artistic + clean**



Our Instagram should feel almost like flipping through a beautifully designed wedding magazine.



Some slides may feature one incredible photograph by itself. Others may feature two or more complementary photographs together. The pacing and image selection should feel intentional rather than simply placing photos into a template.



### Most Important: You Need a Great Eye for Photography



We don't want to have to select every photograph for you.



We will give you the gallery, and we want you to be able to recognize:



- Strong compositions

- Genuine emotion

- Beautiful light

- Interesting candid moments

- Images that work well together

- Hero images that deserve their own slide

- Small details that help tell the story

- Which photographs best showcase our talent as photographers



The goal is for us to hand you a wedding gallery and receive a finished carousel that we're excited to post.



### Who We're Looking For



You may be a great fit if you:



- Have strong graphic design skills

- Have excellent visual taste

- Understand photography and visual storytelling

- Are comfortable working independently

- Have experience with Canva and/or Adobe InDesign

- Understand Instagram carousel design

- Pay close attention to cropping, spacing, alignment, and image sequencing

- Can follow an established brand style while still being creative



Experience working with **photographers, wedding professionals, luxury brands, magazines, or editorial design** is a big plus.



### To Apply



Please send:



1. A short introduction about yourself.

2. Examples of Instagram carousel, editorial, photography, or similar design work you've created.

3. Which program you prefer to use: **Canva or Adobe InDesign**.

4. Your hourly rate or preferred rate per carousel.



**Please also answer this question in your application:**



If you were given a gallery of 700 wedding photographs and needed to create a 15–20 image Instagram carousel, how would you d
 which photographs to use?



We're specifically looking for someone with a strong creative eye, so your portfolio and answer to this question will be very important.



This has the potential to become consistent, ongoing work with our brand.

title: Strategy Manager — Research & Marketing Strategy
description:
About the Role 



If you are the person who reads three sources when one would do—and cannot let a “because that's how it works in this industry” go unchecked—this role may be for you. 



Rohring Results is a US-based marketing agency providing SEO, Google & Meta Ads, social media, content, creative,
 marketing, and web development for clients across multiple industries. 



We are hiring a Strategy Manager to own the strategic direction behind our client work. 



This is not a single-channel marketing role. You will connect research, positioning, SEO, paid advertising, social media, content,
, creative, and web strategy into one coherent plan. 



More importantly: 



This is a research job with a strategy title. 



Your job is to find out what is actually true about a market, a buyer, a competitive landscape, and a client's position—and then determine what the client should do about it. 



When the research is strong, everything downstream becomes stronger. When the research is shallow, every channel can end up confidently solving the wrong problem. 



What You'll Actually Do 



1. Lead Client Strategy 



-You will own the strategy for new clients, including: 

-Developing the overall marketing strategy and direction 

-Connecting multiple channels into one integrated plan 

-Identifying the client's biggest growth opportunities 

-Determining what should be prioritized and why 

-Translating research into clear strategic recommendations 

-Making sure SEO, paid, social, content,
, creative, and web efforts work toward the same objectives 



2. Conduct Deep Marketing Research 



-You will personally conduct or direct research involving: 

-Buyer and audience research 

-Customer personas 

-Competitive analysis 

-Industry and market research 

-Brand positioning 

-Audience research for paid campaigns 

-Competitor messaging and offer analysis 

-Market trends and opportunities 



We are looking for someone who actually does the research, not someone who simply delegates it. 



You should be able to take a research project, explain your methodology, show your sources, challenge your assumptions, and explain how you determined that your conclusions were reliable. 



3. Build Brand Foundations 



Many of our clients do not have clearly defined brand guidelines or positioning. 



You will help establish: 



-Brand positioning 

-Differentiation 

-Target audience 

-Brand voice 

-Key messaging 

-Value propositions 

-Messaging angles 



Our copywriters and designers will use these strategic foundations to create the actual deliverables. 



You don't need to be the person writing every headline. You need to know which headline should exist and why. 



4. Review and Approve Content & Creative 



You will have real strategic authority over work before it reaches the client. 



You will: 



-Review content and creative deliverables 

-Identify when something does not align with strategy 

-Give clear and actionable feedback 

-Approve or reject work before client delivery 

-Explain why something needs to change 

-Ensure the final output reflects the research and strategy 



You should be comfortable telling someone, including someone who does not report to you, that their work is not ready—and giving them enough direction to fix it. 



5. Direct
 Campaign Strategy 



You will determine: 



-Target audience 

-Campaign objective 

-Offer 

-Messaging angle 

-Sequence 

-Call to action 



Our copywriter will write the
s. 



You provide the strategic brief and approve the final work. 



6. Analyze Client Performance 



You will produce and review client performance reports using AI-assisted tools. 



But generating a report is only the beginning. 



You will need to determine: 



-What actually happened? 

-Why did it happen? 

-Which numbers matter? 

-Which numbers are misleading? 

-What changed from the previous period? 

-What should we do next? 

-Does the data actually support the story the report is telling? 

-We need someone who can question the report, not just format it. 



AI Is a Major Part of This Role 



Every agency says it uses AI. 



Here's what we actually mean. 



Our teams already use AI to draft, research, brainstorm, and refine work. That is not what makes this position different. 



Your job is to be exceptionally good at getting reliable information out of AI tools—and knowing when the information is wrong. 



You will be expected to: 



-Frame research questions that produce specific, useful answers rather than generic summaries 

-Build effective prompts and research workflows 

-Iterate instead of accepting the first response 

-Cross-check AI-generated information 

-Identify unsupported claims and hallucinations 

-Understand what an AI model can and cannot reliably know 

-Know when AI should not be used 

-Use primary sources, customer reviews, forums, sales calls, interviews, analytics, and other sources when appropriate 

-Turn research into documented, reusable strategic resources 

-Anyone can get an answer from AI. We need someone who can determine whether the answer is actually true. 



During the hiring process, we may assess this skill directly. 



If you can describe a time when an AI tool gave you an answer that looked correct but wasn't—and explain how you caught it—we want to hear about it. 



What You'll Own 



-Overall marketing strategy for new clients 

-Integrated multi-channel strategy 

-Market and industry research 

-Buyer and audience research 

-Competitive analysis 

-Brand positioning and differentiation 

-Customer personas 

-Paid advertising audience strategy 

-Content and creative direction 

-Content and creative approval 


 campaign strategy 

-Client performance reporting 

-Strategic recommendations based on performance data 

-Ongoing independent research 

-Documentation of research methods and strategic frameworks 

-Dedicated Research Time 



A portion of every week will be protected for research that is not tied to a specific client. 



This is intentional. 



We want someone who actively studies markets, competitors, technology, consumer behavior, marketing trends, and emerging opportunities. 



Nobody will necessarily be waiting for the output. 



That's the point. 



You need to be the kind of person who can take unstructured time and turn it into something valuable. 



 

What We're Looking For 



Required 



Multi-Channel Marketing Strategy Experience 



You have experience setting direction across multiple channels, ideally including: 



-SEO 

-Google Ads 

-Meta Ads 

-Social Media 

-Content Marketing 


 Marketing 

-Brand Strategy 



We are not looking for someone who specializes in one channel and simply coordinates the others. 



Strong Research Experience 



You have personally conducted work such as: 



-Market research 

-Competitive analysis 

-Customer research 

-Personas 

-Brand positioning 

-Audience research 

-Industry analysis 



Be prepared to walk us through a real project in detail. 



Genuine Curiosity 

One of the strongest indicators of success in this role is curiosity. 

We want someone who has gone deep into a subject simply because they wanted to understand it. 

It does not have to be marketing. 

Strong AI Research Skills 

You understand AI as a research and reasoning instrument, not simply a faster way to write. 



You should be comfortable: 

-Prompting 

-Iterating 

-Fact-checking 

-Comparing sources 

-Challenging AI outputs 

-Building repeatable AI research workflows 



We may assess this skill live. 



Strong Critical Thinking 



You naturally ask: 



-How do we know this? 

-What is the source? 

-What assumption are we making? 

-What would prove this wrong? 

-Is there another explanation? 

-What information are we missing? 

-Comfortable Giving Direct Feedback 



You will have authority over work produced by other team members. 



You need to be comfortable saying: 



“This isn't right yet.” 



More importantly, you need to explain exactly what needs to change and why. 



-Self-Directed 

-Some of the most important work in this position will not come with a deadline. 

-You need to be able to identify valuable work, prioritize it, and execute without someone constantly telling you what to do next. 

-Communication 

-Excellent written English 

-Strong analytical communication 

-Comfortable working with US-based clients and colleagues 

-Able to explain complex strategic ideas clearly 

-Comfortable participating in client-facing discussions 



 



Nice to Have 



Experience with: 

-Digital marketing agencies 

-Google Ads 

-Meta Ads 

-Paid audience and targeting strategy 

-Google Search Console 

-GA4 

-SEO platforms and analytics 

-Marketing dashboards and reporting 

-Competitive intelligence 

-Brand strategy 

-Marketing automation 

-AI research workflows 

-Creating documented processes that another person can follow 



 

What This Job Is NOT 



This may not be the right role if you are primarily looking for: 



A content writing position 



An SEO specialist position 



A paid ads specialist position 



A social media manager position 



A role where someone else provides the strategy 



A position where you simply execute instructions 



A job where AI is used primarily to generate content faster 



Our copywriters write. Our designers design. Our specialists execute. 



You determine what should be done, why it should be done, who it should reach, and how we know it is working. 



 

About the Working Environment 



This is a senior individual contributor position. 



There are no direct reports, but the role comes with real strategic authority. 



Client-facing work does not move forward without your approval. 



Rohring Results is a growing company, so not every process is perfectly established. Part of this role will involve helping us improve and document how strategy is developed and delivered. 



Our delivery team primarily works on Philippine hours, including daily stand-ups. 



Some client-facing meetings may take place during US hours. We will explain the expected schedule during the interview process. 



 



How to Apply 



Please submit your CV/Resume along with two short paragraphs answering the following: 



1. A Research Question You Answered Well 



Tell us: 



What were you trying to find out? 



How did you conduct the research? 



What sources did you use? 



How did you evaluate the information? 



How did you know your conclusion was reliable? 



What decision did the research ultimately influence? 



2. A Time AI Gave You the Wrong Answer 



Tell us about a situation where: 



An AI tool gave you an answer that appeared reasonable 



You discovered that it was wrong or misleading 



Explain how you identified the problem 



Explain how you verified the correct information 



Explain what you changed in your process afterward 



We read these answers before the rest of the application. 



Send to 



They will tell us much more about how you think than a generic cover letter.

Pay: [$60 weekly ] plus [EARN A $10 BONUS FOR EACH QUALIFIED DEMO THAT THE PROSPECT ATTENDS, PLUS $25 WHEN THAT PROSPECT BECOMES A PAYING MEDINA SOLUTIONS CLIENT AND THEIR FIRST PAYMENT CLEARS. NO APPOINTMENT BONUS FOR NO SHOWS, DUPLICATES, OR UNQUALIFIED PROSPECTS.]  |  Start: [October 1, 2026. Paid onboarding and training begin on this date. The date may shift by mutual agreement. TRAINING: The first week includes training on Medina Solution’s services, call script, zoom, calling process, zoho lead tracking, appointment qualification, and role-play practice. Training time is paid at the stated hourly rate.Live calls begin with coaching, and regular targets start in week 2.]

Medina Solutions helps US small businesses answer customer calls and book appointments with an AI receptionist. We also build websites for businesses that need one. We are hiring two appointment setters for the same role. You will call assigned owners, learn how they handle calls, mention a website when a real need appears, and book qualified meetings with our founder. You will not build websites, configure the receptionist, quote unapproved terms, or close contracts.

What you will do

• Call assigned, checked leads and reach the owner or appropriate decision maker.

• Ask how the business handles missed calls, after hours inquiries, spam calls, and appointment booking. Explain the approved AI receptionist offer accurately.

• Check the business website status. If it has no website or the owner describes a specific website problem, ask permission to discuss that need; offer a relevant website conversation without dropping a live receptionist opportunity.

• Book one meeting with the founder for the service or services the owner actually wants. Confirm name, business, phone,
, date and time, stated pain point, and service interest.

• Log each attempt, outcome, objection, next action, website status, and follow up in Zoho. Check duplicates and honor removal requests.

• Send approved confirmations, complete callbacks, flag high intent prospects, and submit the daily scorecard.

Three hour daily workflow

• First 10 minutes: review assigned leads, due follow ups, script, phone, CRM, and calendar.

• Next 130 minutes: focused calls and immediate CRM updates; ask about website need only when supported by the conversation or verified website status.

• Next 30 minutes: callbacks, meeting confirmations, and incomplete qualification notes.

• Final 10 minutes: hand off booked meetings and submit the scorecard.

Three hour daily workflow

• First 10 minutes: review assigned leads, due follow ups, script, phone, CRM, and calendar.

• Next 130 minutes: focused calls and immediate CRM updates; ask about website need only when supported by the conversation or verified website status.

• Next 30 minutes: callbacks, meeting confirmations, and incomplete qualification notes.

• Final 10 minutes: hand off booked meetings and submit the scorecard.

Qualifications and equipment

• Clear spoken and written English; experience in outbound calling, appointment setting, sales, or customer service.

• Good discovery questions, natural delivery, accurate notes, and coachability. Familiarity with Zoho, a dialer, and Google Calendar is helpful.

• Reliable computer, stable internet, quality headset, quiet workspace, and backup internet or power plan when possible.

How to apply

• Subject line: MEDINA SETTER followed by your first name.

• Briefly describe your B2B calling and appointment setting experience.

• Attach a 60 to 90 second voice sample: introduce an AI receptionist and naturally bring up a website only after a plausible website need is revealed.

• Answer the six questions below in order. Include a recent internet speed screenshot & equipment , requested pay for 15 hours weekly, and confirmation of the posted shift.

Application questions

• What questions would you ask to learn whether an owner is missing calls or bookings?

• If the business has no website, how would you introduce that offer while preserving interest in the receptionist?

• What would you say if the owner replies, “My staff already answers the phone”?

• Which details must be confirmed before a meeting is booked, and how would you record interest in both services?

• Which dialers, CRMs, and calendars have you used? Give one example of improvement after call coaching.

• Can you work the exact shift Monday through Friday for at least 90 days?

description:
Application form:



Role Overview



A family-owned plumbing and gas business is hiring a part-time Virtual Assistant to take full ownership of day-to-day bookkeeping and take a meaningful chunk of admin and field coordination off the owner's plate. This is a bookkeeping-led role, not a generalist VA role. The business needs someone with genuine Australian bookkeeping experience plus prior exposure to Tradify or a comparable trades platform, ideally with plumbing or trades industry background.



The role starts at four hours a day, with an openly stated expectation that it will grow to full-time within roughly two to three months as tasks get offloaded and trust builds. Success looks like the owner no longer touching daily reconciliation, invoicing, or chasing the field team for job updates — with a VA who can independently manage the books, keep the job platform accurate, and start picking up quoting for straightforward maintenance jobs over time.



Working Hours: Monday to Friday, 4 hours/day Position Type: Part-Time Virtual Assistant (with a clear path to Full-Time) Reporting To: Business Owner/Director, with a second-in-charge as a secondary point of contact



What You'll Own



Financial Management & Bookkeeping



Daily bank reconciliation (transitioning from a weekly cycle previously run by a contract bookkeeper)

Raising and sending customer invoices in the job management platform

Matching supplier bills and receipts against jobs, coding to the correct job/cost centre

Weekly payroll processing, including entering staff hours into the accounting platform — currently a manual step, as time logs don't sync automatically

Keeping the books current and handover-ready for the accountant ahead of quarterly BAS

Flagging any invoicing or coding errors before they reach the accountant

Chasing overdue invoices on a set schedule — standard terms are 7 days for smaller jobs, different terms for major builders, and overdue payments are a recurring issue



Field & Job Coordination



Following up with the field team throughout the day to confirm job updates are logged correctly (materials used, job notes, job status/whereabouts) — flagged as one of the owner's biggest daily time drains and a priority early handover

Managing the job calendar for maintenance/call-out style work: booking jobs in, confirming appointment times with customers

Adjusting the schedule when jobs run over or get rescheduled, and notifying affected customers

Flagging schedule clashes or gaps before they become a problem



Customer Communication & Documents



Monitoring the admin and accounts inboxes each morning, triaging urgent vs non-urgent messages

Responding to routine customer inquiries directly, escalating pricing or complaint issues to the owner

Checking and actioning submissions through the website contact form

Drafting routine business documents (letters, forms, tender-support paperwork) from a template or verbal brief, formatting and tidying them ready for review before anything goes to a client

Preparing quotes for straightforward maintenance/call-out jobs from job notes or a verbal brief — larger, plan-based quotes stay with the owner for now, flagged as a longer-term "phase two" handover, not a day-one expectation

Following up outstanding quotes on a set cadence



Online Presence



Responding to inquiries via the website and social media

Logging new leads and following up to book a quote or job

Keeping the Google Business Profile current and complete: business hours, services listed, regular photo uploads

Basic upkeep of social media and occasional website updates



Systems & Records



Keeping customer and job records accurate and up to date

Uploading and updating pricing files when material costs change

Pulling basic job/revenue reports

Documenting SOPs for each task as it's handed over



What We're Looking For



Experience



Australian bookkeeping experience — non-negotiable

Experience with Tradify or a comparable trades platform (e.g. ServiceM8, Simpro)

Plumbing or trades industry exposure — a strong preference



Technical Proficiency



Tradify: essential, prior experience valued

MYOB: prior experience a bonus (the business runs MYOB, not Xero — Xero experience is considered comparable/transferable)

Microsoft Word for documents (not Google Docs)

Comfortable accessing plan/document repository platforms as part of working with a major building partner — training provided

Comfortable with WhatsApp for daily communication and video calls for training



Non-Negotiables



Comfortable working with a business owner who is often on the tools and communicates in quick bursts (messages, voice notes) rather than long structured briefs

Able to build a predictable daily/weekly routine without needing constant direction

Confident to ask clarifying questions and flag things early, and comfortable suggesting a better way of doing something based on prior client experience

Strong written English for admin and document work

Fast learner on the job management and accounting platforms if not already experienced on the specific ones used

Comfortable starting part-time with an openly stated expectation that hours may grow toward full-time

Discreet and trustworthy — will have access to financial records, supplier relationships, and job data across the business



Why This Role



Real ownership of the books and field coordination for a well-established, profitable trade business

Clear, near-term path from part-time to full-time as trust and scope grow

Fast, tangible early wins — take a major daily time drain off the owner's plate from week one

Work directly with a straightforward, no-fuss business owner who values a good working relationship over red tape



How to Apply



To be considered, please complete this form. It helps us shortlist quickly

title: Power BI Developer (Embedded Analytics)
description:
We are a SaaS platform that helps large organisations manage their property portfolios: assets, leases, facilities and maintenance. Our customers use the dashboards inside our product to make decisions about buildings, budgets and risk. We want someone who can make those dashboards sharper, faster and more useful.



Initially this is a part time role.  However, we are a growing business and a number of people who started with us part time initially have expanded into full time roles within the team. 



What you'll do

• Build and maintain Power BI reports embedded in our product, connected to live data through APIs.

• Design clear visuals, including custom 2D visuals using SVG (site plans, floor layouts, condition maps).

• Model data well: clean relationships, efficient DAX, reports that load fast.

• Document every report in Confluence so anyone on the team can understand, support and extend it.

• Work with our engineers and implementation team to turn customer needs into dashboards that get used.

• Help validate customer data as new clients come onto the platform.



What you'll bring

• 3+ years building Power BI reports, including reports connected to live data via REST APIs.

• Strong data modelling and DAX. Power Query (M) as a working tool, not a last resort.

• Experience creating SVG-based visuals in Power BI.

• Disciplined documentation habits. You write things down without being asked.

• Clear written and spoken English, and the confidence to push back with a better solution.

• Ability to work an early shift for overlap with New Zealand business hours.



Bonus points

• 3D or spatial visuals, such as building plans or digital twin views.

• Power BI Embedded, deployment pipelines, or advanced features like calculation groups and field parameters.

• Using AI tools (Copilot, Q&A or similar) for data exploration, trend analysis or natural language queries.

• Property, facilities or asset management data.

• PL-300 or equivalent certification.



Why join

• Your work ships into a product used daily by enterprise customers.

• Small team, direct access to the founder and engineers, real ownership.

• Room to grow into implementations, data quality and analytics leadership as we scale.

• Fully remote. [Salary band] PHP per month plus [benefits].



How to apply

Please send:

• A cover letter or message that outlines: what you want out of your next role, what your superpower is when it comes to work and what motivates you at work.

• Your CV.

• 2 to 3 examples of Power BI dashboards you have built (screenshots or a PDF if a live board is not available). Redact any commercially sensitive or personal information, including client names, financial figures and identifying data, before sending.

• A few lines on the most complex report you've maintained and how you documented it.

Applications without Power BI examples will not be considered.



Renumeration: We are happy to look at either an hourly contract rate, or fixed contract rate.  *Final rates will be subject to experience and final negotiations.

title: Senior Bookkeeper / Xero Specialist – UK Property Group
description:
UK Property Investment, Development & Rental Business



About the Role:



Oasis Holdings Limited is a UK-based property investment and management group with several companies operating in London.



Our activities include:



Property investment and development



Long-term residential rentals



HMO properties



Short-term / vacation rentals



We are looking for an experienced Senior Bookkeeper / Xero Specialist based in the Philippines to take responsibility for the day-to-day accounting, reconciliations and management reporting across several UK companies.



This is a long-term position for someone who is highly proficient in Xero and capable of working independently.



We are not looking for a junior bookkeeper or someone who has only basic Xero experience.



The successful candidate will work directly with the company directors and management in the UK, so excellent spoken and written English is essential.



Key Responsibilities:



You will be responsible for maintaining accurate accounting records for several UK companies, including:



Day-to-day bookkeeping in Xero



Bank and credit card reconciliations



Investigating and resolving unreconciled or incorrectly recorded transactions



Correcting historical bookkeeping issues where required



Accounts payable and accounts receivable



Recording and reconciling rental income



Property-level income and expenditure



Intercompany transactions and reconciliations



Maintaining supporting documentation and audit trails



Month-end reconciliations



Preparation of monthly management accounts



Profit & Loss and Balance Sheet reporting



Cash-flow reporting



Budget versus actual reporting



Assisting with preparation of year-end accounts



Liaising with our UK accountants where required



Xero Expertise – Essential



We need someone who is an advanced Xero user, ideally Xero certified.



You should fully understand Xero rather than simply know how to enter transactions.



You must be comfortable with:



Bank feeds and reconciliation



Bank reconciliation problems



Chart of Accounts



Tracking categories



Accounts payable and receivable



Journals and correcting entries



Balance Sheet reconciliations



Management reports



Multi-company accounting



VAT-related bookkeeping



Month-end and year-end procedures



Identifying and correcting accounting errors



An important part of the position will be reviewing our existing Xero setup and helping us improve our accounting processes, controls and reporting.



Property Accounting:



Previous experience working with UK property, real estate or property-management businesses is highly desirable.



Our portfolio includes long-term rentals, HMOs, property development and short-term accommodation.



You should therefore be comfortable understanding transactions relating to individual properties and producing useful property-level financial information.



Arthur Online:



We use Arthur Online as our property-management system and document repository.



Arthur Online is being integrated with Xero to improve the management of rental income and property-related transactions.



Experience with Arthur Online and Xero integration would be a major advantage.



If you have not used Arthur Online, you should be technically confident and capable of learning new accounting and property-management software quickly.



Short-Term Rentals / Hospitable:



We also operate short-term and vacation rental properties and use Hospitable as our channel manager.



Experience with short-term rental accounting is desirable, particularly:



Airbnb and other booking-platform income



OTA/platform commissions and fees



Payout reconciliations



Cleaning and operating expenses



Booking income reconciliation



Property-level profitability



Previous experience with Hospitable would be advantageous but is not essential.



Excel & PowerPoint



You must have strong Microsoft Excel skills and be comfortable working with financial data.



This may include:



Financial analysis



Cash-flow forecasts



Budgets



Management reporting schedules



Property performance analysis



Reconciliation schedules



Investor reporting



You should also be proficient in Microsoft PowerPoint, as you may assist with preparing professional presentations and financial information for investors.



English Communication – Essential



Excellent spoken English is a critical requirement for this position.



You will communicate directly with directors and management in the UK through video calls and online meetings.



You must be able to:



Speak English clearly, confidently and professionally



Understand spoken British English



Participate confidently in Zoom/Teams meetings



Explain accounting problems clearly in English



Ask appropriate questions when information is unclear



Write clear and professional
s and reports



Communicate problems proactively rather than waiting to be asked



Applicants must be comfortable participating in a video interview conducted entirely in English.



Required Skills & Experience



We are looking for candidates with:



At least 3–5 years of relevant bookkeeping/accounting experience



Advanced practical Xero experience



Xero certification preferred



Experience preparing monthly management accounts



Excellent bank reconciliation skills



Strong understanding of Profit & Loss and Balance Sheet accounts



Strong Excel skills



Good PowerPoint skills



Excellent spoken and written English



Excellent attention to detail



Strong analytical and problem-solving skills



Ability to work independently



Reliable internet connection and suitable home working environment



Ability to work and communicate effectively with a UK-based management team



Experience with UK accounting, property businesses, Arthur Online, Hospitable or short-term rentals will be highly regarded.



Working Relationship:



We are looking for someone interested in developing a long-term working relationship with our business.



For the right person, the role has the opportunity to develop beyond bookkeeping into broader management accounting, financial reporting, property performance analysis and investor reporting as our portfolio grows.



How to Apply:



To help us identify applicants who have carefully read the job description, please include the following information with your application:



How many years have you used Xero professionally?



Are you Xero certified? If yes, please provide details.



Have you prepared monthly management accounts? Please describe your experience.



Have you worked for a UK company or UK clients previously?



Do you have property or real-estate accounting experience?



Have you worked with long-term rentals, HMOs or short-term/vacation rentals?



Have you used Arthur Online? If yes, please explain how you used it.



Have you used Hospitable or another short-term rental/channel-management system?



Please rate your Excel skills and briefly describe the most advanced Excel work you regularly perform.



What is your current availability and notice period?



What are your expected monthly salary/rate in PHP?



Please also include a short 1–2 minute video or voice introduction in English.



In your introduction, briefly tell us about your accounting experience, your experience with Xero and why you believe you would be suitable for this position.



Applications that do not address the questions above may not be considered.

title: AI Instagram Reel Generator / Editor
description:
COMPENSATION

$650 a month + generous performance bonuses if all goes well month 1. We want someone long-term. If you're reliable and your output is good, this grows into a stable full-time position with increasing pay.



We create short-form health and wellness video content for
 and Instagram using AI-generated avatars. We're looking for one reliable person to handle our video production start to finish.



Here's the best part: you don't have to think of ideas, write anything, or find your own images. We give you the script. We give you the base reference images. Your job is to turn those into a finished video.



IMPORTANT - PLEASE READ BEFORE APPLYING: This is not an entry-level or "willing to learn" role. We need someone who is ALREADY EXPERIENCED with AI video generation and CapCut editing. Applications without a portfolio will not be reviewed.



WHAT YOU'LL DO



1. Generate images using Higgsfield (Nano Banana Pro) - take the reference photos we send you and adjust them so they match our AI avatar characters consistently

2. Generate video using Google VEO 3 from the scripts and images we provide

3. Edit the final video in CapCut - captions, cuts, timing, hook framing, clean delivery

4. Deliver finished videos ready to post, on schedule



We reimburse you for all AI software costs (VEO 3, Higgsfield, etc.). You never pay out of pocket for tools.



REQUIREMENTS (please only apply if you meet these)



- Experience with Google VEO 3 - this is our primary video generation tool

- Experience editing short-form vertical video in CapCut (Reels / TikTok / Shorts)

- Hands-on experience with AI image generation - Higgsfield / Nano Banana Pro experience is a major plus

- A portfolio we can look at with finished videos you've edited and AI content you've generated.

- Strong attention to detail - our avatar characters must look CONSISTENT across every video. Same face, same look, every time. This is the single most important part of the job.

- Reliable daily availability (4 hours/day) and consistent communication

- Good English skills to understand video tutorials and written instructions

- Stable internet and a computer that can handle video editing



NOT REQUIRED: scriptwriting, marketing knowledge, coming up with ideas, or sourcing content. We handle all of that. We just need someone who is excellent at execution.





HOW TO APPLY



Please send:



1. Your portfolio / work samples - links to short-form videos you've edited (Reels, TikToks, Drive folder, or website). This is required.

2. Examples of AI-generated video and images you've created, especially anything made with Google VEO 3

3. A list of the AI tools you've used (VEO 3, Higgsfield, Nano Banana Pro, Midjourney, Runway, Kling, etc.) and how long you've used each

4. Your daily available hours and time zone

5. Start your application with the word "AVATAR" so we know you read the full post



Applications without a portfolio or work samples will not be considered.

title: Social Media & Email Marketing Virtual Assistant
description:
Social Media &
 Marketing Virtual Assistant

Rare and Bossy Boutique

Remote | Part-Time | 20 Hours Per Week | $5/hr





About the Brand



Rare and Bossy is an identity-based jewelry boutique. We sell lightweight wood and resin earrings, and everything we do is built around one belief: women are worth celebrating exactly as they are.



The brand was founded by Lila Bennett, who survived 5 strokes and temporary blindness during childbirth and built something meaningful on the other side of that. This is not just a jewelry business. It is a community of women who know who they are and show up for each other.



Because this brand is built by women and for women, we are looking for someone who genuinely lives in that world and connects with that mission.





The Role



We are looking for a detail-oriented, self-directed Virtual Assistant to help execute our social media and
 marketing. You will be managing and posting content on our TikTok account, with hopes of building more accounts in the future, as well as sending
 campaigns through Shopify. You will be working from an existing brand guide and content library. Your job is to execute, stay organized, and keep things moving.



This position starts at 20 hours per week with the potential to grow to 40 hours as the brand scales.



Please note: systems are still being built. You will need to be flexible, proactive, and comfortable working in a growing brand where not everything is perfectly documented yet. If you need everything figured out before you can start, this role is not the right fit.





What You Will Be Doing



- Managing and posting content on our TikTok account

- Sending and scheduling
 campaigns through Shopify

- Editing and scheduling TikTok videos: adding music, creating text overlays, and optimizing for format

- Creating and scheduling TikTok posts and behind-the-scenes content

- Organizing a large existing content library of photos and video clips by category

- Designing branded graphics in Canva using existing templates

- Maintaining consistency across all content: labels, captions, and calls to action

- Communicating regularly with the founder via WhatsApp, including turning around additional content quickly when needed

- Flagging low inventory, milestones, and anything that needs the founder's attention





What You Need



- Strong video editing skills: this is non-negotiable due to the volume of video editing required

- Proficiency in Canva

- Experience managing TikTok accounts

- Familiarity with
 marketing platforms

- High attention to detail and the ability to follow documented systems without needing to be redirected

- Comfort communicating via WhatsApp and responding quickly when content needs to go out fast

- A genuine appreciation for women's empowerment content and community-first brands

- Comfort working in an evolving environment where you may need to help build the process, not just follow it.





Nice to Have



- Experience with Shopify

- Background in fashion, jewelry, or lifestyle brands

- Experience supporting a founder-led brand

- Strong communication skills and comfort engaging with customers directly on social platforms

- Experience with lead generation





To Apply

title: Experienced Senior Project Manager (Amazon FBA | Full-Time)
description:
# Join a Fast-Growing E-Commerce Brand Based in Singapore



We’re a fast-growing Singapore-based Amazon FBA brand looking for a highly capable **Amazon E-Commerce Director / Senior Project Manager** to help us scale.



This is not a coordinator role.



We’re looking for someone who can **see the big picture while being highly meticulous with the details**. You should be comfortable managing people, analysing data, improving systems, identifying problems early, and taking ownership of execution.



## What You’ll Be Responsible For



You’ll oversee a team of around 6 people across listings, design, and operations.



You’ll manage product launches and Amazon projects from planning through execution.



You’ll review sales, profitability, advertising, inventory, conversion, rankings, and other key data to identify opportunities and risks.



You’ll coordinate suppliers, freight forwarders, inspection agents, inventory planning, production, and shipping.



You’ll review Amazon listings carefully, including keywords, images, backend data, attributes, variations, dimensions, weights, and size tiers.



You’ll maintain accurate dashboards and reporting so management always has a clear view of the business.



You’ll identify bottlenecks and recurring problems, then improve the systems behind them rather than repeatedly fixing the same issues.



## We Want Someone Data-Driven



You should naturally ask questions like:



Why did sales increase or decrease?



Where are we losing margin?



Which products are underperforming and why?



Are we ordering too much or too little inventory?



What are the biggest risks over the next 30, 60, or 90 days?



We do not want someone who simply reports numbers.



We want someone who can **interpret the data, identify what matters, and recommend what we should do next.**



## Attention to Detail Matters



Amazon is a business where small mistakes can become expensive quickly.



Wrong dimensions, incorrect listing data, inventory mistakes, inaccurate spreadsheets, or missed shipping timelines can directly affect profitability.



You should be naturally **careful, structured, meticulous, and willing to double-check important work before execution.**



## Think Like a Director



We want someone who can gradually operate at a director level.



You should be able to understand where the business is going, what the team should prioritise, what risks management should know about, and which processes need improvement.



You should not need to be told every single thing to do.



If you see a problem, raise it.



If you see an opportunity, propose it.



If something does not make sense, question it.



## Managing People



You’ll manage and coordinate a team of around 6 people.



You should be able to set clear expectations, assign responsibilities, track progress, identify bottlenecks, and hold people accountable without simply chasing for updates.



## AI and Technology



We actively use AI to improve research, listings, analysis, reporting, operations, and project management.



AI is a tool, not a replacement for thinking.



We expect you to use it to work faster and make better decisions while still applying your own judgment and checking the output carefully.



## Tools You’ll Use



Amazon Seller Central

Google Sheets and Docs

Notion

Helium 10

DataDive

Zoom

AI tools and internal systems



## What We’re Looking For



At least **5 years of relevant experience**, ideally in Amazon FBA or e-commerce operations.



Strong working knowledge of Amazon Seller Central and backend workflows.



Experience with listings, inventory, product launches, and operational processes.



Strong analytical skills and confidence working with spreadsheets and dashboards.



Excellent attention to detail.



Experience managing people and multiple projects.



Strong problem-solving and communication skills.



Commercial awareness and an understanding of how decisions affect revenue, profit, cash flow, and growth.



Able to work independently without constant supervision.



Proactive, open-minded, and comfortable challenging assumptions when something can be improved.



## Working Hours



Monday to Friday

12 PM to 10 PM Singapore time

1-hour break

Remote

44 hours per week



## How to Apply



Please include:



A short introduction and why you’re a good fit.



Clear details of your Amazon FBA experience.



Your most recent role and what you personally owned.



Examples or references to Amazon brands or projects you have worked on.



Examples of teams or projects you have managed.



A short video introduction if possible.



Please also tell us about **one Amazon or e-commerce problem you identified through data, what you discovered, and what action you took.**



## Important



Only candidates with genuine Amazon FBA experience will be considered.



This role is for someone who can already operate independently and contribute at a senior level.



We’re looking for someone who can become a **key operator in the business: someone we can trust with the numbers, the people, the details, and the bigger picture.**

title: Short-Form Video Editor + Content Researcher - Running / Fitness Niche
description:
About the role



I'm growing a personal Instagram account in the running and fitness space — lifestyle-driven, authentic content rather than heavily produced videos.



I'm looking for someone to help me research what's working in the niche and turn my raw footage into Reels at a consistent volume.



This is two jobs in one, and I need both:



Research — you stay close to what's performing in running and fitness Reels and document it.

Editing — you take my footage and cut it into short-form Reels.



If you're strong at one and weak at the other, this probably isn't the right fit.



What you'll do

Spend focused time daily inside running and fitness content on Instagram, tracking what's performing and why.

Keep a shared research doc organized and current so we always have a running list of ideas to pull from.

Edit short-form vertical Reels from an organized library of my raw footage.

Write natural, native-sounding on-screen text. This matters a lot — a strong edit with a weak or stiff hook won't perform.

Deliver consistently at volume. This isn't one polished video a week.

Keep our tracker updated so we both know where every video stands.



You'll send me work for review, I'll approve or give notes, and we'll keep a steady loop going. Async is fine — I don't need you online at set hours, but I do need you responsive and consistent with deadlines.



What I'm looking for

Real experience editing short-form vertical video for Instagram Reels or TikTok. Portfolio required.

Fluent, natural written English — you'll be writing text that has to sound like a native speaker wrote it.

Comfort in CapCut and/or Premiere Pro. After Effects is a bonus, not a requirement.

A genuine feel for hooks, pacing, and retention. You can look at a Reel and explain why it held attention.

Organized and self-directed. Trackers and docs stay current without me chasing you.

Reliable communication. If something slips, you tell me before I have to ask.



Bonus points:



You run, or you're into fitness generally. You'll be watching this content daily — it helps if you actually enjoy it.

Experience helping grow an account from a small starting point, personal or client.

You already have a system for finding trending content and audio.



Details:



Pay based on experience. Tell me your rate. I'd rather pay well for someone genuinely good than hire cheap and redo the work.

Long-term intent. I'm looking to build something with someone over time, not fill a one-off gig.

Paid test project before any ongoing commitment, so we both know it's a fit.



How to apply:



Please include all of the following. Applications missing any of these won't be reviewed:



Your portfolio. If you have short-form vertical edits, lead with those.

One Instagram Reel from the running or fitness niche that you think performed well, and why. Two or three sentences.

Your rate and weekly availability.

Which editing software you use.





Looking forward to seeing your work.

title: Shopify Developer: Build a Custom Checkout Connected to Slash Payments (Fixed Price Project)
description:
PLEASE READ TO THE END. Applications that do not start with the password word will not be read.



ABOUT US

Fitmo (
) is a direct-to-consumer wellness brand: the Tetra smart bracelet, the Vitro smart band and the Soma smart scale. The store runs on Shopify and most of our customers are in the United States.



THE PROJECT

We are moving part of our US card payments from Shopify Payments to Slash Payments, the new payment processing product from Slash (
). Slash does not provide a hosted checkout, a payment link or a Shopify app. It provides an API (payment intents, refunds, webhooks) and a React payment form (npm 
 Payments runs on Whop's payment infrastructure. The product is new and in beta, so part of the job is to check with Slash's docs and support what our account supports before building.



So we need a developer to build and connect a fully custom checkout from A to Z. When a US customer clicks the main "Checkout" button on our Shopify store, they land on our own checkout page at 
, pay through Slash, and the paid order is created in Shopify automatically, like any normal Shopify order.



WHAT YOU WILL BUILD

- A checkout web app (React or Next.js, hosted on our Vercel account) at 
: contact, shipping address, shipping method, discount code, order summary, and payment through Slash by card, plus Apple Pay and Google Pay if Slash enables them on our account.

- A split cart for US visitors with a USD cart: one big main "Checkout" button that goes to the new Slash checkout, and right under it two smaller buttons, Shop Pay and PayPal, that open the native Shopify checkout express flows, so these customers keep their one-click payment and pay in 4. Every other visitor and currency stays on the normal Shopify checkout.

- The same rule on every checkout entry point of our theme (cart drawer, cart page, Buy it now buttons, checkout links in the theme).

- Server-side pricing from Shopify: products, discount codes, automatic discounts, bundles, shipping rates and US sales tax. Prices sent by the browser are never trusted.

- Creation of the order in Shopify after a successful Slash payment, with idempotency (never a duplicate order) and a reconciliation job (never a lost paid order).

- Refunds: a refund made in the Shopify admin is executed in Slash.

- Tracking: Meta Pixel plus Conversions API with event_id deduplication (exactly one Purchase per order), a Klaviyo Started Checkout event, UTM parameters saved on every order, and which cart button was clicked (main, Shop Pay or PayPal).

- A confirmation page, an order bump before payment, and the standard Shopify order confirmation
.

- A rollback switch that sends every cart back to the Shopify checkout in one click, plus an A/B split to send only part of the traffic to the new checkout.

- Tests in every market (US, UK, Canada, Europe), on iPhone and desktop, and a short written handover: how to run it, how to roll back, how to replay an order.



A full technical brief is ready and will be sent to shortlisted candidates.



MUST HAVE

- You have already built an external checkout for a Shopify store that went live. A theme customization does not count.

- Shopify Admin GraphQL API: order creation, including draft orders (draftOrderCalculate, draftOrderComplete) and orderCreate.

- Integration of a payment API: payment intents, webhooks with signature checks, idempotency keys, refunds. Experience with Stripe, Whop, Adyen or NMI counts.

- Apple Pay and Google Pay domain verification on a subdomain.

- Meta Pixel plus Conversions API with event_id deduplication.

- React or Next.js, Node.js, a database (Postgres or similar), deployment on Vercel.

- Clear written English and a short progress update every working day.



NICE TO HAVE

Whop Elements, the Klaviyo API, Shopify Markets and multi-currency, Shopify accelerated checkout buttons, previous work with CrispCheckout, Lasso or Checkout Champ.



HOW TO APPLY

Write the word VITRO at the very top of your application. Then answer these 6 points:

1. Links to external checkouts you built for Shopify stores (live URL or a screen recording), and the payment processor each one used.

2. How would you create the Shopify order after payment, and how do you guarantee that no paid order is ever lost or created twice?

3. How do you make sure Meta counts exactly one Purchase per order when the Pixel and the Conversions API both send it?

4. How would you handle discount codes, automatic discounts, shipping rates and US sales tax outside the Shopify checkout?

5. Your fixed price for the whole scope, what it includes, and your timeline in days.

6. Your availability in hours per week and your usual working hours (we work on Paris time).



BUDGET AND PAYMENT

- Fixed price for the whole project. Our budget is 200 to 600 USD. Quote your own price. If your quote is higher, explain what it covers.

- We pay per project, in two milestones (the split between them is agreed before the start): first when the checkout works end to end on the test setup with real orders created in Shopify, then after go-live and 7 days with every paid order present in Shopify.

- Bug fixes during the 14 days after go-live are included in the price.

- Later changes and new features are paid separately, per request, at a price agreed before the work starts. We are looking for a developer we can come back to.

- We own the code, the repository and every account used for the project.

, collects and normalises the quotes into a comparison table, builds a cost plan from the pricing sheet, raises quotes and purchase orders in Xero, and reports budget vs committed cost per job. The supplier sheet, the quoting SOP and the Xero file already exist.



Project 2 — AI finance team: Claude Code agents that review client bookkeeping in Xero (coding, reconciliations, GST), assemble month-end management packs to our Excel template, create referenced workpapers from source documents, and draft variance commentary — each with a human review gate before anything is sent.



Across both: MCP servers connecting Claude to Xero, Microsoft 365 (Outlook, SharePoint, Excel) and our data stores; evaluation harnesses so we know when an agent's output is wrong; overnight unattended runs; written documentation good enough that the firm is not dependent on you to operate what you built.



Requirements

Shipped Claude Code work in production: subagents, CLAUDE.md / skill files, hooks, multi-agent orchestration. You can show it.

Built or integrated at least one MCP server in production.

Python or TypeScript to a professional standard; Git/GitHub daily.

API integration with an accounting, CRM or ERP platform (Xero API is a strong plus); OAuth, webhooks, JSON, rate limits.

Testing and evaluation discipline: you can explain how you measure whether an agent's output is correct, not just whether it ran.

Excellent written English — you will document every system and write for a non-technical reader.

Reliable internet with backup power; available during business hours (Mon–Fri, UTC+8).

Nice to Have

n8n, Make or Zapier for glue work; Supabase/Postgres; Microsoft Graph API

Experience with structured-output extraction from PDFs (drawings, quotes, invoices)

Any exposure to accounting, bookkeeping or construction estimating

Open-model experience (Llama, Qwen, Mistral) for cost-sensitive workloads

How We Work



Weekly sprint with written goals; a working demo every Friday. Everything in Git with a README. Secrets in a vault, never in chat. All IP is assigned to the firm under a contractor agreement and NDA. Shortlisted candidates complete a paid four-hour test build; the successful candidate starts on a paid 30-day trial against Project 1 milestones.

Our clients are small business owners who occasionally need extra help setting things up, making changes, troubleshooting problems, or implementing something new.



You will work directly with the client, and the client will pay you $10 USD/hour for the hours they need.



This is ideal for an experienced HighLevel VA who wants to add additional client work to their schedule.



What You'll Help Clients With



Depending on the client, you may help with:

- Workflows and automations

- Calendars and appointment settings

- Forms and funnels

-
 and SMS

- Pipelines and opportunities

- Domains, DNS, and
 sending domains

- A2P 10DLC and phone setup

- Integrations

- Contact imports

- Troubleshooting

- New HighLevel features, including AI tools



You don't need to know every single feature in HighLevel. You DO need to know the platform well enough to investigate problems and figure things out without waiting for someone else to tell you what to do.



Don't Apply Unless You Meet These Criteria



You must:

- Have at least 2 years of hands-on HighLevel experience

- Have personally built and configured HighLevel accounts

- Be able to troubleshoot HighLevel independently

- Speak and write excellent English

- Be comfortable meeting directly with US-based clients on Zoom

- Be patient working with clients who aren't tech-savvy

- Be highly organized and detail-oriented

- Communicate proactively and follow up when you need something from a client

- Have reliable internet and a backup internet option

- Be available for our team meeting on Mondays at 10:00 AM Eastern Time



We're looking for someone who doesn't just complete a task and disappear.



If something isn't working, you investigate it. If you're waiting for information, you follow up. If you see a better way to accomplish something, you speak up.

When a client needs additional HighLevel help, we'll introduce them to you.

title: Bookkeeper – MYOB Australian Experience Required

Australian-Experienced MYOB Bookkeeper (Philippines) – Immediate Start



Remote | Philippines | Part-Time Ongoing | Immediate Start

PHP 300–400/hour depending on experience — higher rate considered for an exceptional candidate



We are a growing Australian digital media business looking for an experienced Philippines-based MYOB Bookkeeper to take responsibility for the day-to-day bookkeeping of our Australian company.



This is not an entry-level position.



You must have previous hands-on bookkeeping experience for Australian businesses, strong MYOB experience, and practical knowledge of Australian GST and BAS preparation.



Immediate Priority



Our bookkeeping is currently several months behind, so the first priority is to bring our MYOB accounts fully up to date.



We need someone who can start immediately and dedicate additional hours during the initial catch-up period.



Once the catch-up is complete, this will become an ongoing part-time role, expected to be approximately 10–15 hours per week, with the potential to grow.



About the Business



We are an Australian digital media and content business operating multiple YouTube channels, websites, Amazon influencer/affiliate businesses and international brand partnerships.



We operate through an Australian GST-registered company and use MYOB.



Our income and expenses include:



* Australian and international brand partnerships

* Amazon and affiliate income

* AUD and USD payments

* International payment platforms

* Australian and overseas contractors and suppliers

* Normal Australian business expenses



Because of this, experience with multi-currency and online/international businesses would be particularly useful.



Responsibilities



You will be responsible for:



* Bringing our existing MYOB bookkeeping fully up to date

* Ongoing bookkeeping in MYOB

* Bank and credit-card reconciliations

* Correctly categorising income and expenses

* Correct Australian GST coding

* Preparing accurate accounts and records for BAS reporting

* Reconciling AUD and foreign-currency transactions

* Recording and reconciling international brand and affiliate income

* Contractor and supplier transactions

* Receipts, invoices and supporting documentation

* Reviewing unreconciled or unusual transactions

* Identifying missing documentation and requesting what you need

* Month-end reconciliations

* Maintaining accurate, current accounts

* Liaising with our Australian accountant/BAS agent when required



REQUIRED Experience



Please apply only if you have:



* Previous professional bookkeeping experience for Australian businesses

* Strong, recent hands-on MYOB experience

* Practical Australian GST experience

* Experience preparing bookkeeping/accounts for BAS

* Bank and credit-card reconciliation experience

* Experience reviewing and correcting existing bookkeeping

* Good understanding of accounting/bookkeeping principles

* Excellent attention to detail

* Good written and spoken English

* Ability to work independently and take ownership of the accounts

* AUD/USD transactions

* Wise, PayPal or Stripe reconciliation

* Amazon or affiliate income

* E-commerce, digital media or online-business experience



What We Want



We are looking for someone who understands the accounts rather than simply entering transactions.



If something does not reconcile, investigate it.



If something appears to have been coded incorrectly, flag it.



If information or documentation is missing, ask for it.



If you are uncertain about the GST treatment of a transaction, do not guess.



We want someone reliable who can take ownership of the bookkeeping and keep it current going forward.



For the right person, this is intended to be a stable, long-term role.



Pay



PHP 300–400 per hour depending on experience and qualifications.



We will consider a higher rate for an exceptional candidate with extensive Australian MYOB, GST and bookkeeping experience.



Additional hours will be available initially while the bookkeeping is brought up to date.



How to Apply



Start your application with:



XERO AUSTRALIA

4. Briefly describe your practical experience with Australian GST and preparing accounts/records for BAS.

7. When can you start, how many hours can you dedicate to the initial catch-up over the next two weeks, and what is your expected hourly rate in PHP?



Please answer each question directly.



Generic applications that do not demonstrate Australian Xero and GST/BAS experience will not progress to interview.

title: Company Controller | US Construction, Job Costing & WIP
description:
We are seeking a highly experienced Company Controller to serve as the senior accounting lead for an established Hawaii-based multi-trade contractor supporting commercial and institutional facilities.



The company provides roofing, HVAC/R, commercial doors, electrical, plumbing, and general maintenance services. The Controller will own the financial books, job-cost integrity, month-end close, and management reporting while partnering closely with company leadership and operations.



This is not a routine bookkeeping or data-entry role. The successful candidate must be capable of independently overseeing the company’s complete accounting function and turning operational activity, including work orders, vendor bills, payroll, subcontractor costs, and customer billings, into accurate financial information leadership can trust.



The position is fully remote and open to qualified Philippines-based professionals under an independent-contractor arrangement.



Key Responsibilities



*Financial Accounting and Close

Own the full accounting cycle from transaction coding through month-end and year-end close

Maintain the general ledger, chart of accounts, and accounting policies

Lead monthly, quarterly, and annual closing activities according to an established calendar

Prepare accurate trial balances and financial statements

Reconcile cash, accounts receivable, accounts payable, prepaid expenses, accrued liabilities, WIP, retainage, fixed assets, and other balance-sheet accounts

Prepare and review journal entries and investigate unusual variances before reports are released

Coordinate with external CPAs, tax advisers, auditors, and other accounting professionals as needed

Maintain accounting practices consistent with US GAAP or other company-adopted standards



*Job Costing, WIP and Project Financials

Maintain accurate job-cost records for labor, materials, equipment, subcontractors, overhead, and other direct costs

Prepare and review work-in-progress schedules

Identify underbilling, overbilling, cost overruns, missing costs, billing gaps, and potential margin risks

Ensure job costs and WIP accurately reflect the operational status of each work order or project

Partner with operations, project managers, and administration to ensure completed work, approved quotes, NTEs, customer invoices, and applicable revenue-recognition practices remain aligned

Provide actual-versus-estimate and gross-margin analysis for active and completed jobs

Communicate financial risks and discrepancies to leadership promptly



*Accounts Receivable and Billing Oversight

Oversee customer invoicing workflows to ensure completed work is billed promptly and accurately

Monitor accounts-receivable aging and coordinate follow-up on past-due balances

Reconcile customer deposits, progress billings, retainage, credit memos, and related accounts

Work with operations and administrative teams to secure the supporting documentation required for customer billing and payment



*Accounts Payable, Vendors and Subcontractors

Oversee accounts-payable intake, coding, approval routing, and payment runs

Ensure vendor and subcontractor invoices are assigned to the correct jobs or work orders

Maintain complete vendor records, payment terms, and applicable W-9 or tax documentation

Prevent duplicate payments and assist in resolving invoice discrepancies and vendor disputes



*Cash, Banking and Working Capital

Maintain clear daily and weekly visibility of cash balances, upcoming obligations, and expected receipts

Reconcile bank and credit-card accounts and clear outstanding items promptly

Prepare or support cash-flow forecasts for company leadership

Help improve working capital through effective billing, collections, and payment timing



*Payroll Coordination and Cost Allocation

Coordinate with internal or outsourced payroll providers

Ensure labor costs are allocated to the correct jobs, departments, and general-ledger accounts

Review payroll liabilities, employer taxes, benefits accruals, and related accounts for completeness

Support appropriate labor-burden and overhead-allocation methods for job costing



*Reporting, Controls and Systems

Prepare recurring management reports, including the income statement, balance sheet, cash position, AR/AP aging, job profitability, and WIP

Translate financial results into clear, practical recommendations for leadership

Design, document, and strengthen internal controls appropriate to the company’s size and operations

Maintain audit-ready records and documentation

Reconcile accounting systems, work-order or CMMS exports, and spreadsheet trackers

Identify opportunities to improve financial processes, systems, and source-data quality

Document accounting procedures to ensure continuity and consistency

Protect confidential company, financial, customer, vendor, and employee information



*Cross-Functional Partnership

Work closely with company leadership, directors, project and resource management, operations, and administration

Help operations understand job profitability, margins, cash flow, billing issues, and cost-control opportunities

Support system implementations, historical account cleanup, new entities or locations, and other special projects

Guide or train administrative staff responsible for entering bills, invoices, payroll information, or job costs



*Qualifications and Skills

Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field

Proven experience as a Controller, Assistant Controller, or Senior Accountant in construction, facilities services, field services, or another project-based business

Strong knowledge of full-cycle accounting, general-ledger management, and financial reporting

Demonstrated experience independently leading month-end and year-end close

Strong job-costing and WIP experience within a project-based or work-order environment

Working knowledge of US GAAP

Strong understanding of accounts payable, accounts receivable, cash flow, internal controls, and audit readiness

Advanced Microsoft Excel skills

Experience with QuickBooks Online/Desktop, Xero, NetSuite, or similar accounting systems

Comfortable learning work-order, CMMS, or facilities-management platforms

Excellent written and spoken English for communication with US-based stakeholders

Strong analytical skills and the ability to explain financial information clearly

High level of integrity, ownership, accuracy, and professional judgment

Able to work independently and meet strict reporting and closing deadlines

Reliable internet connection, secure workspace, and appropriate remote-working equipment



*Preferred Experience

Philippine-licensed CPA, US CPA, or equivalent professional accounting qualification

Previous experience supporting a US-based company

Accounting experience in construction, facilities services, field services, or another project-based industry

Direct experience with job costing, WIP, retainage, progress billing, labor allocation, and revenue recognition

Experience working with multiple trades, departments, entities, or locations

Experience partnering directly with company owners, executives, operations leaders, or project managers

Experience supervising, reviewing, or training accounting and administrative team members



*Schedule and Work Arrangement

Full-time; exact weekly hours and schedule to be confirmed

Fully remote and open to Philippines-based candidates

Independent-contractor engagement

Must be available for scheduled collaboration with Hawaii-based leadership

Regular overlap with Hawaii Standard Time will be required for meetings, accounting questions, month-end close, billing deadlines, and other time-sensitive matters

Candidates must clearly state their availability and time zone



How to Apply

Please submit the following:

- A brief application letter introducing yourself and explaining your relevant Controller experience

- A link to your updated résumé or CV

- A summary of your experience with US accounting and US GAAP

- Details of your construction, job-costing, WIP, retainage, or project-accounting experience

- A list of the accounting, ERP, work-order, and reporting systems you have used

- Your current availability and ability to overlap with Hawaii Standard Time

- Your expected hourly rate or monthly compensation in USD

- Confirmation of any active CPA license or equivalent professional accounting qualification, if applicable



Please ensure that all submitted links are accessible.


 Subject Line

CONTROLLER REPS – YOUR FULL NAME



Only complete applications that follow the instructions above will be considered.

title: Senior Accountant
description:
Senior Accountant (Remote)



Close the books. Lead the team. Automate the busywork.



Ledger is an accounting firm for US startups and small businesses. We handle full-cycle accounting and financial reporting, and we use automation and AI to move faster without cutting corners.



We're hiring a Senior Accountant who can do the work, review it, and lead the people doing it. You'll own the close for a set of clients, manage a small team, run projects from start to finish, and help us find smarter ways to handle the manual parts of accounting.



What you'll do



Own the close



Run the monthly close for your client portfolio: reconciliations, accruals, prepaids, fixed assets, deferred revenue, and financial statements

Keep bank, card, payroll, and spend platform activity flowing cleanly into the GL

Prepare adjusting entries with clear support behind every line

Build workpapers that tie back to source reports

Write short commentary a founder can read in a minute



Lead and develop people



Review staff and junior accountant work before it reaches the client

Assign work, set priorities, and keep closes on schedule

Give clear review notes and coach on the "why" behind each correction

Spot repeat issues and fix them at the source



Run projects



Lead cleanups, catch-up work, system migrations, and new client onboarding

Scope the work, set the timeline, and own the outcome



Build with AI and automation



Use tools like Claude and Codex every day, from ledger review and commentary to reconciliations and workpapers

Build and maintain workflows that remove manual steps from the close: transaction coding, rec matching, JE imports, and client requests

Check AI output with the same care you'd give a teammate's work

Share what works so the whole team gets better



Work with clients



Be a go-to contact for founders and finance teams

Ask for what you need, explain findings plainly, and join close reviews



What you bring



4+ years in accounting, with at least 2 in a firm, audit, or multi-client role

Experience reviewing work and managing or mentoring staff

Solid US GAAP: accruals, revenue recognition, prepaids, fixed assets, and leases

Advanced QuickBooks Online, plus experience with Gusto and Ramp

Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills (linked formulas, not typed-in numbers)

Comfort running several closes at once and hitting deadlines

Clear, simple written English and strong communication

A proactive, problem-solving mindset

Professional skepticism: when something doesn't tie, you find out why instead of forcing it



Nice to have



Hands-on experience with Claude, Codex, ChatGPT, or similar tools

Workflow building with Zapier, Make, or simple scripts

CPA (US or PH), or working toward it

E-commerce or startup accounting experience

System migrations or historical cleanups



How we work



Every number traces to support

Work gets reviewed before it goes to a client

If a task repeats, we automate it

We write plainly, with no jargon in anything a client reads



Ready to build a better close with us? Send your CV to
