title: Bookkeeper & Accounts Administration Assistant
description:
Part-Time Xero Bookkeeper & Accounts Administration Assistant

All Maintenance & Renovations Ltd is an Auckland-based construction, renovation and property maintenance business in New Zealand.

We are looking for a reliable and detail-focused Part-Time Xero Bookkeeper & Accounts Administration Assistant to join us on a long-term basis.

The main purpose of the role is to keep our Xero records current, supplier and accounts documents organised, and job costing information up to date.

Main Responsibilities

• Keep Xero up to date

• Enter supplier bills

• Match customer payments

• Reconcile straightforward Xero transactions

• Check and process supplier invoices, receipts and statements

• Download invoices from supplier portals such as Bunnings and Mitre 10

• Save invoices, receipts and statements into the correct folders

• Keep accounts-related Outlook
 organised

• Enter receipts, materials and supplier costs into our job management system

• Allocate costs to the correct construction job

• Add and maintain products and materials

• Identify missing invoices, receipts or unclear transactions

• Keep a simple list of anything requiring management review

Systems We Use

• Xero

• Microsoft Outlook

• NextMinute

NextMinute is a New Zealand construction job management system used for job costing, supplier costs, receipts and products.

Previous NextMinute experience is not required. Training will be provided.

We may move to JACK App in the future, so you should be comfortable learning new software.

What We Are Looking For

• Strong practical Xero experience

• Previous bookkeeping or accounts administration experience

• Very good attention to detail

• Good written and spoken English

• Experience working with invoices, receipts and financial records

• Ability to follow processes carefully

• Confidence to ask questions when something does not make sense

• Ability to work independently once trained

• Your own computer

• Reliable home internet and a backup internet option

Experience with a New Zealand or Australian business would be an advantage.

Construction, trade or job-costing experience would also be an advantage, but is not essential.

Hours 

15 hours per week

Usually 3 hours per weekday, Monday to Friday.

Future Responsibilities

As you become familiar with AMR’s systems, the role will gradually expand to include:

• Payroll preparation

• Supplier statement reconciliation

• Accounts receivable and payable checking

• Invoice preparation

• More detailed job-cost checking

• Detailed weekly accounts reporting

• Monthly accounts administration

• Helping improve our internal processes

• Supporting our future transition from NextMinute to JACK App

Important

Our rule is simple:

If you are unsure, do not guess. Ask.

You will not be expected to make independent tax, GST or complex accounting decisions.

How to Apply

Please begin your application with:

AMR ACCOUNTS

Then answer these questions:

1. How many years of bookkeeping experience do you have?

2. How many years have you used Xero?

3. Have you worked for a New Zealand or Australian business before?

4. Have you worked with a construction, trade or job-costing business?

5. Are you currently working for another employer? If yes, how many hours per week?

6. Are you comfortable with the advertised pay?

7. Do you have your own computer, reliable home internet and a backup internet option?

8. Tell us about a time when information did not make sense. What did you do?

Finally:

You receive a Mitre 10 invoice for building materials but there is no job number or property address. You cannot tell which AMR job it belongs to. What would you do?

This is a long-term position, not a short-term freelance project.

title: Customer Support Specialist · Dropshipping E-commerce (French or Irish store)
description:
Who we are



We run e-commerce stores in the French and Irish markets. This position is to handle customer support for one of these stores. The workload is manageable, usually 50 to 100
s per month, often less. We have full SOPs in place so you know exactly how to handle every type of ticket that comes in.



What you'll do



You'll be the voice of the brand for your store's customers. Every type of ticket that comes through an e-commerce store:



Where-is-my-order questions and stuck tracking

Refund requests, exchanges, and size issues

Damaged or missing packages

Quality complaints

De-escalation of frustrated customers

Retention and turning a complaint into a kept customer



You'll follow our SOPs, which cover every common situation with tested templates and clear rules. Where the SOP leaves room, you use your own judgement.



Compensation and growth



This is a starter role. Starting pay is $80 per month, paid via IBAN once a month.



That is the entry point. From there, there is a real growth path. As you prove yourself, take on more responsibility, and show that you can handle more (more stores, more volume, or a management layer), the compensation grows with you. This is not a permanent $80/month position, it's the starting point of a career path with us.



What we need from you



Native or fluent French (for the French store) or native English (for the Irish store)

Some experience with customer support, ideally for an e-commerce or Shopify store

You can follow an SOP without needing constant supervision

You write like a human, not a corporate template

You respond quickly and reliably within your working hours

Available at least 1 to 2 hours per day, consistently

Comfortable in Gmail and Shopify



If you have limited experience but you're eager to learn and you can write well in the required language, still feel free to apply. What matters most is your reliability, your communication, and your willingness to grow into a bigger role.



Why this role is worth your time



Low-volume, structured work with clear guidelines. You're not thrown into chaos, you're following a proven system.



You work directly with the owner. No middle management.



Genuine growth path. If you deliver, we invest in you. The pay grows, the responsibility grows, and there's room to become a customer support manager as we scale.



How to apply



Reply with:



A short message telling us which store you're applying for (French or Irish), and your relevant experience

A 1-2 minute Loom video in the language of the store you're applying for (French or English), introducing yourself

One example of a customer situation you've handled and how you resolved it (or, if you have no CS experience yet, how you would handle a customer who is upset about a delayed order)



The first week is a paid trial on real tickets under supervision. If it clicks, we move forward.



Start: immediate.

title: Real Estate Lead Manager / ISA — U.S. Wholesale Real Estate
description:
I’m looking for a sharp, confident, organized Lead Manager / Inside Sales Agent (ISA) to join my growing U.S. real estate investment business.



This is not a general VA or administrative position. This is a sales-focused role.



Your main objective is simple:



Create qualified conversations with motivated homeowners and book qualified seller appointments on my calendar.



I handle acquisitions, property analysis, offers, negotiation, and contracts. Your responsibility is to own the seller pipeline leading up to that appointment.



What You’ll Own



1. PPL / Incoming Leads



-Contact new motivated-seller leads as quickly as possible

-Call and text new leads

-Qualify the seller and property

-Consistently follow up with leads who don’t immediately respond

-Schedule qualified appointments directly onto my calendar



Fresh inbound leads are always the highest priority.



2. SMS / Text Campaigns



-Help manage outbound SMS campaigns inside XLeads

-Monitor and respond to incoming text conversations

-Identify interested and motivated property owners

-Call promising SMS leads when appropriate

-Qualify interested sellers

-Schedule qualified appointments

-Properly manage opt-outs and lead statuses



3. Cold Calling



When there are no fresh inbound leads or priority follow-ups:

-Cold call targeted homeowner lists

-Start natural conversations with property owners

-Identify potential motivation

-Qualify interested sellers

-Schedule qualified appointments

-Follow up with prospects who aren’t ready today



Lead Management & Follow-Up



You will help own the seller database inside XLeads CRM.



Every lead should have accurate:



-Notes

-Status/stage

-Follow-up date

-Tasks

-Contact history

-Motivation

-Property condition

-Timeline

-Price expectations

-Decision-maker information

-Next action



No legitimate opportunity should disappear because someone forgot to follow up.



Priority Order



Your work should generally follow this order:



1. Fresh PPL/inbound leads

2. Hot SMS responses

3. Scheduled follow-ups

4. SMS campaign management

5. Cold calling



If a fresh motivated-seller lead comes in while you’re cold calling, you stop and work the fresh lead.



Speed-to-lead matters.



What Happens After You Book an Appointment



Once you’ve properly qualified a seller, you’ll schedule the appointment with me and leave detailed notes so I’m fully prepared.



I take over from there:



Property analysis → seller appointment → offer → negotiation → contract



Your job is to make sure I’m spending my time speaking with legitimate seller opportunities.



Who I’m Looking For



You should:



* Speak excellent, natural English

* Be comfortable speaking with U.S. homeowners

* Have a confident and friendly phone presence

* Be comfortable making a high volume of calls

* Be able to build rapport instead of simply reading scripts

* Ask good follow-up questions

* Be persistent without being pushy

* Have strong written English for SMS conversations

* Be extremely organized

* Take excellent CRM notes

* Be coachable

* Be dependable

* Be competitive and results-driven

* Be comfortable being measured by performance



Previous experience with U.S. real estate, wholesaling, real estate investing, ISA work, lead management, cold calling, or motivated sellers is strongly preferred.



Experience with XLeads is a bonus but isn’t required.



How Performance Will Be Measured



We will track metrics such as:



* Speed-to-lead

* Calls/conversations

* Contact rate

* Follow-up completion

* Qualified seller leads

* Qualified appointments scheduled

* Appointment show rate

* CRM accuracy

* Opportunities generated

* Contracts and closed deals resulting from leads you manage



I’m not looking for someone who simply checks boxes or logs hours.



I’m looking for someone who wants to become an important part of a growing real estate business.



Schedule & Compensation



Starting schedule: Approximately 25–30 hours per week



You must have availability during U.S. Eastern Time business hours so incoming leads can be contacted quickly.



Starting compensation: $4–$6 USD/hour depending on experience and ability, with the opportunity to earn additional performance bonuses from closed deals.



There is an opportunity for increased hours, compensation, and responsibility as the business grows.



How to Apply



Please send:



1. Your previous sales and/or real estate experience.

2. Any experience you’ve had with U.S. real estate investors or wholesalers.

3. Your cold-calling experience.

4. Your experience managing SMS/text campaigns.

5. CRMs you’ve previously used.

6. Your desired hourly rate.

7. Your availability in U.S. Eastern Time.

8. A 60–90 second voice recording introducing yourself and explaining why you’d be good at speaking with motivated homeowners.



Applications without a voice recording will not be considered.



Finally, begin your application with the words:



“SELLER FIRST”



This lets me know you read the entire job posting.

description:
We are building a modern luxury real-estate business in California that uses AI employees and automation to improve client service, database follow-up, marketing execution, reporting, and internal efficiency. We are looking for a technically capable, highly organized AI Systems & Automation Specialist to help us build and operate that system.

What you will own

Build, refine, and maintain a team of 10 specialized AI employees.

Create reliable workflows using ChatGPT/OpenAI tools plus Zapier, Make, n8n, or comparable automation platforms.

Turn business outcomes into repeatable AI workflows, not just one-off prompts.

Document every workflow with clear SOPs, inputs, outputs, owners, QA checks, and escalation rules.

Monitor AI outputs for quality, hallucinations, missing context, stale data, and process failures.

Connect AI workflows to Google Workspace, spreadsheets, marketing systems, and Follow Up Boss when appropriate.

Prepare structured outputs for the EA rather than creating duplicate CRM work.

Build dashboards and exception queues so the founder only sees what actually requires her.

Continuously identify repetitive work that can be simplified, automated, or removed.

The person we want

Hands-on experience with ChatGPT and AI workflow design.

Strong experience with at least one automation platform: Zapier, Make, or n8n.

Comfort with APIs, webhooks, JSON, data mapping, and troubleshooting integrations.

Excellent written English and strong SOP/documentation skills.

Able to test your own work and explain why a workflow is reliable.

Comfortable working independently from an outcome rather than needing step-by-step instructions.

High attention to detail and strong judgment about what should—and should not—be automated.

Experience with CRMs is preferred. Follow Up Boss experience is a bonus, not the main requirement.

U.S. real-estate experience is helpful but not required if your AI/automation skills are strong.

Schedule + structure

Start at approximately 20 hours per week.

Long-term role for the right person; hours should grow to full time if useful work justifies them.

Overlap with Pacific Time for a small number of scheduled meetings is preferred, but the role does not need full U.S. business-hour coverage.

30-day paid trial, followed by a formal 60- and 90-day review.

Please send: (1) a short introduction, (2) 2–3 examples of AI or automation systems you personally built, (3) the tools used, (4) the business problem each system solved, (5) what failed or had to be corrected, and (6) a 2-minute Loom/video walking us through one workflow. Start your application with the words “Luxury Real Estate AI System.”

Our SEO team has four specialists under a department lead. This seat owns everything off-page: backlink audits, toxic-link decisions, outreach campaigns, guest posts and self-published articles for clients. We have the platform and the content engine to do this well, and we are hiring someone to run the outreach side as a real practice. 



Our writing engine drafts placement content. You d
 whether it is good enough to ship, where it goes, and who we pitch. 



What you will do 



-Audit each client's backlink profile and flag the links that hurt it. 

-Find and qualify publishers, write pitches and land guest posts and mentions. 

-Approve and publish client articles on platforms like Medium, LinkedIn and Substack. 

-Make disavow decisions and log your reasoning. 

-Turn our quarterly off-page research into a prioritized work queue.

-3+ years in off-page SEO with outreach, guest posting or digital PR, and placements you can show.

-Pitches that editors answer.

We are still building. Some of our processes are newer than we would like. You will help shape how this work runs, not only follow a finished playbook.

title: Senior Operations Manager & Executive Assistant to the Founder · Remote · Long-term opportunity ·
description:
We are looking for an organized, resourceful and results-driven professional to work directly with Dr Larissa Miller, founder of Vista Clinic Australia and Melbourne Aesthetic Medicine Institute.



Our work connects an established Melbourne clinic with medical education, international doctor visits, professional awards, skincare and art-led branding. Your role is to keep daily operations running smoothly and turn agreed ideas into completed projects, coordinating the Melbourne team, contractors and suppliers.



This is an opportunity for someone who enjoys responsibility, variety and building a lasting professional relationship, with room to develop and take greater responsibility as the businesses grow.

What you will take ownership of



Daily operations: Coordinate clinic administration, bookings and patient communication with the on-site team. Follow up outstanding matters, monitor service standards and resolve operational issues.

Executive support: Manage the founder’s calendar, correspondence, meeting preparation and follow-up. Protect her time and ensure important decisions move forward.

Project delivery: Translate agreed priorities into practical plans with clear responsibilities, budgets and deadlines. Coordinate people and follow through to completion.

Suppliers and stock: Monitor inventory reports, purchasing, deliveries and supplier commitments, helping prevent shortages and unnecessary costs.

Medical education and international visits: Organise training logistics, registrations, visiting doctors’ schedules, venues, travel and professional communications.

Awards and events: Maintain accurate records, coordinate invitations and correspondence, and organise event logistics and follow-up.

Skincare and art branding: Coordinate online order administration, suppliers, packaging, designers, website updates and launches, maintaining consistent presentation.

Systems and accountability: Maintain a central project tracker, improve procedures and provide concise weekly reports covering results, outstanding issues, spending and decisions needed.



Priorities and decision-making authority will be agreed with the founder. Physical clinic duties will be handled by the on-site team, with your coordination and follow-up.



Your experience and approach



You have demonstrated experience in operations, project management or senior executive support, including working directly with a business owner. You can explain what you personally managed and show the results.

Experience in an aesthetic or cosmetic clinic, healthcare business, professional skincare company or medical education organization would be particularly valuable. Experience coordinating professional training, events, suppliers or international stakeholders is also welcome. You do not need expertise in every area.



You bring:



Strong written and spoken English and confident communication with doctors, clients, suppliers and colleagues.

Initiative, practical judgement and the ability to organize competing priorities.

Consistent follow-through, attention to detail and a habit of closing outstanding tasks.

Confidence with spreadsheets, project management tools and online business systems.

Discretion and disciplined handling of patient, business and personal information, using approved systems and security procedures.

Honest communication: you acknowledge mistakes, raise concerns early and propose solutions.

The confidence to contribute ideas, respectfully question a decision and recognize when approval is required.

Preparation and attention to detail matter in this role; please include the year Vista Clinic Australia was founded in the title or subject line of your application.

We value someone who remains calm under pressure, takes responsibility and works respectfully with others. Experience supporting Australian businesses is an advantage.

What success looks like

Projects are completed within agreed deadlines and budgets. Daily matters are resolved, records are accurate, and staff and suppliers understand their commitments. Problems are identified early, with practical options for resolving them. The founder has clear visibility of progress and spends less time chasing tasks.

What we offer

Direct collaboration with the founder across varied, connected businesses.

Meaningful responsibility, agreed priorities and regular feedback.

Opportunities to develop your skills and expand your scope as you demonstrate results.

An initial three-month review of responsibilities, performance and remuneration, followed by regular reviews.

We appreciate loyalty and want to look after the people who help our businesses succeed. We aim to build a lasting relationship through respect, dependable payment, support, recognition and opportunities to grow. We welcome candidates looking to contribute and develop with us over several years.

How to apply

Please send:

Your CV and a brief explanation of why this role suits your experience and long-term goals.

Two examples of measurable results you personally delivered.

One example of a project you managed from an initial idea through to completion.

Your location in the Philippines, availability, preferred working hours and expected monthly remuneration.

Be specific about what you owned, what you did and what changed as a result.

Shortlisted candidates may be invited to a structured interview and a short paid practical exercise. References will be requested with your permission.

title: b2b cold caller/ appoitment setter- u.s. vending company

s when appropriate

There is room to grow into greater creative or paid media strategy ownership as you demonstrate results.



HOW TO APPLY



Apply through OnlineJobs.ph with your resume or LinkedIn profile, expected monthly compensation, and confirmation that you can work US Pacific Time business hours. Include:

This position is for someone who already understands the U.S. credit repair industry and can confidently review credit reports, identify disputable items, process disputes, and manage client files.



## Responsibilities



- Review credit reports from Experian, Equifax, and TransUnion

- Identify inaccurate, incomplete, or questionable information

- Prepare and process credit disputes

- Manage dispute cycles and follow-ups

- Review responses and update client accounts

- Maintain accurate client notes and documentation

- Monitor deadlines and client progress

- Communicate with the team regarding client accounts

- Follow company processes and compliance guidelines



## Qualifications



- At least **1 year of credit repair/disputing experience**

- Previous experience working with a **U.S. credit repair company preferred**

- Strong understanding of the three major credit bureaus

- Familiarity with credit reports, collections, late payments, charge-offs, inquiries, and other negative items

- Knowledge of **FCRA and FDCPA basics**

- Experience with credit repair/dispute software preferred

- Strong attention to detail

- Good written English and communication skills

- Organized and able to manage multiple client files

- Reliable and able to work independently

- Stable internet connection and reliable computer



## How to Apply



Please send the following:



1. A short introduction about yourself

2. Your credit repair/disputing experience

3. How long you have worked in the U.S. credit repair industry

4. Credit repair/dispute software you have used

5. Your resume

6. Your expected monthly salary



**Important:** Start your application with the words **“CREDIT DISPUTER”** so we know you read the entire job post.



We’re looking for someone experienced, dependable, and ready to become a long-term member of our team.

title: Customer Support Representative — E-commerce (Shopify + Gorgias)
description:
Job Description



We are a European e-commerce group running seven Shopify stores in fashion, home and lifestyle. Most of our customers are in the Netherlands, Germany, Denmark and the wider EU.



We are hiring a Customer Support Representative to answer customers in Gorgias every day. You will report to our Customer Support Manager, who will train you on our policies, macros and tone.



This role starts part-time (average 24 hours per week / 6 days a week  —  1 day weekend off) and moves to full-time based on performance. We do this so both sides can be sure it is a fit before committing. Do the work well and the hours grow — this is not a permanent part-time position.



We are looking for someone who wants to do this well for a long time, not someone passing through. Our best support people end up running their own stores' support.



---



What You Will Do



- Answer customer tickets in Gorgias: order status, shipping delays, returns, refunds, exchanges, product questions

- Hit your daily ticket target and keep first response time within our SLA

- Process returns and refunds in Shopify following our policy

- Track orders with our fulfilment partners and follow up on the ones that go quiet

- Use and suggest improvements to our Gorgias macros

- Tag tickets correctly so our reporting is accurate

- Escalate anything outside policy to the Customer Support Manager instead of guessing



---



What We Are Looking For



Required



- 1+ year in customer support, ideally e-commerce (NOT BPO E-COMMERCE)

- Excellent written English — clear, warm, correct grammar, no stiff copy-paste replies

- Comfortable learning Gorgias and Shopify (experience with either is a strong plus)

- Accurate and detail-oriented: you read the full ticket before replying

- Reliable internet (min. 20 Mbps), working computer, quiet place to work

- Able to work EU-overlapping hours

- Shows up on schedule and communicates early when something is wrong



Nice to have



- Previous Gorgias or Shopify experience

- Experience handling returns and refunds for a physical product store

- Familiarity with EU consumer rights basics (14-day right of withdrawal)



---



What We Offer



- Long-term, stable position with a growing e-commerce group

- Clear targets and a manager who answers questions



---



How To Apply



Applications that skip these steps will not be read.



1. Send your updated pdf resume

2. In 1–minute video: tell us about a time you dealt with an angry customer whose order was lost. What did you actually say, and what did you do?

3. Your available working hours in Philippine time. And if you currently have any other work besides applying for us.



We reply to every application that follows these steps.

Soul To Soul – Reaching out to Reach In, Inc. 

The Wives Room

WE’RE HIRING

 Reels, and YouTube Shorts.

Video Editor — Peakfinity Labs

## About Peakfinity Labs



Peakfinity Labs is a manufacturing company focused on supplements and cosmetics. We're looking for a talented Video Editor to help us tell our story — from the factory floor to the finished product — through compelling, high-quality video content.



## About the Role



We're hiring a Video Editor to create engaging video content that showcases our manufacturing processes, products, and company culture. You'll work with raw footage from our facilities and turn it into polished videos for marketing, training, social media, and internal communications.



## What You'll Do



- Edit raw footage into polished, engaging videos for marketing, social media, and internal use

- Cut manufacturing/process footage into clear, compelling narratives

- Add motion graphics, text overlays, color correction, and sound design as needed

- Collaborate with the marketing team on video concepts and messaging

- Manage multiple projects and turnaround deadlines

- Organize and maintain video assets and project files



## What We're Looking For



- Proven experience editing video content (portfolio required — see below)

- Proficiency in editing software such as Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or Final Cut Pro

- Strong storytelling instincts — ability to turn raw, unscripted footage into a clear narrative

- Understanding of pacing, color grading, sound design, and motion graphics

- Comfortable working with industrial/manufacturing footage (a plus, not required)

- Strong attention to detail and ability to meet deadlines



## How to Apply



To apply, please send us:



1. **Your portfolio** — a link or reel showcasing your best editing work.

2. **(Optional, but recommended) A sample edit** — To help us prioritize applications, we invite you to download raw footage from **
** and produce a short edited video (60–90 seconds) that tells a clear, engaging story using the clips provided. We want to see how you structure a narrative, pace cuts, and polish raw material — not just your software skills.



 *Tips for a strong sample edit:*

 - Choose a clear focus or theme rather than using every clip

 - Aim for a logical flow: an opening hook, a clear middle, and a satisfying close

 - Include basic color correction, clean audio, and simple titles/graphics if relevant

 - Keep it tight — quality of storytelling matters more than length



Applicants who submit a sample edit alongside their portfolio will be prioritized for review.

- Troubleshooting broken automations

- Maintaining quality control before anything goes live

- Keeping projects moving without needing to be chased

- Documenting processes so they are clear and repeatable

- Supporting client communication when required



This is a build-first role initially, with a clear path into operations and people leadership.



As our client base grows, you will take ownership of more of the process, delivery and people running it, not just the system builds.





WHAT WE NEED

This is a contractor role, but we treat our people as part of the team and back them for the long term.

The Executive Assistant directly supports the President or Vice President through a variety of administrative duties, client projects, and multi-department teams. These responsibilities include managing the executive’s calendars, taking notes at meetings for action items, directly responding to clients (within prescribed limits) on behalf of the executive, designing materials and presentations for meetings, storing digital files in appropriate locations, and more. To succeed in this role, the Executive Assistant should have excellent time management and remarkable communication skills (written and verbal), as they’ll collaborate with various internal teams to deliver exceptional results on extremely tight deadlines. title: Senior Growth Strategist
description:
ABOUT US



Perfect Selection Marketing (PSM) is a US-based growth agency that primarily works with clothing and apparel brands. Our founder scaled his own apparel brand past $10M, got burned by agencies along the way, and built PSM to do it right. We run paid ads, ambassador programs,
/SMS, and UGC as one system that makes brands profitable, not just busy. We have 30+ clients and are growing fast.



THE ROLE



You'll own a book of 15 to 20 brands. Your job is to look at each brand's numbers, figure out what's actually wrong, and lead the team that fixes it. Our designers, media buyers, and developers execute. You d
 what gets done and why.



This is NOT an account management or VA role. If a client says "I want more ads," we need someone who asks why, not someone who says "great idea."



WHAT YOU'LL DO



- Diagnose each brand's growth problem using ad, site, and customer data

- Build and run growth plans using our proven playbook

- Run weekly account reviews and make scale, hold, or kill calls

- Brief and direct our designers and media buyers

- Lead client video calls with US brand owners, including the hard ones

- Spot churn risk early and find the right upsells



REQUIREMENTS



- 4+ years in performance marketing or growth strategy for e-commerce or DTC brands

- Strong understanding of Meta ads,
, ROAS, CAC, and LTV

- Experience leading client calls with US or international clients

- Confident enough to tell a client something they don't want to hear and keep their trust

- Excellent spoken and written English

- Highly organized, able to manage 15+ accounts without anything slipping

- Full-time availability during US Eastern hours (9am to 7pm EST, Monday to Friday)

- Reliable internet with a backup connection or power source



NICE TO HAVE



- Experience with apparel or fashion brands

- Agency experience with Shopify or DTC clients

- Hands-on experience running paid ads

- Experience leading a team



WHAT WE OFFER



- Performance-based raises

- Room to grow into Director of Growth as we build out strategy pods

- Direct access to a founder who has scaled a $10M+ brand



HOW TO APPLY



1. Your resume

2. Years of experience and the types of brands you've worked with

3. Short answer (5 sentences max): "Tell us about a time a client wasn't getting results. What was really wrong, and what did you change?"

4. Start your application with "Growth Owner"

title: Account Manager / Project Manager
description:
About The Ad Firm



The Ad Firm is a full-service digital marketing agency that helps businesses grow through strategic, results-driven digital marketing. Our services include SEO, local SEO, website development, content marketing, paid advertising, and more.



We work with businesses across a variety of industries and are committed to delivering measurable results, high-quality work, and exceptional service. Our team operates in a fast-paced, collaborative environment where communication, organization, accountability, and follow-through are essential.



As The Ad Firm continues to grow, we're looking for talented, dependable people who take ownership of their work and understand the importance of getting things done. If you're organized, proactive, detail-oriented, and enjoy working as part of a team, we'd love to have you join us.



About the Role



We are looking for a highly organized, proactive, and detail-oriented Account Manager / Project Manager to join our growing digital marketing agency. This role is responsible for keeping client projects, communication, meetings, and internal teams organized and moving forward. You will work closely with our marketing strategists to make sure deadlines are being met, tasks are properly tracked, clients receive timely updates, and nothing falls through the cracks. You will provide critical project and account support to our Service Managers by helping coordinate communication, scheduling, follow-ups, deadlines, and deliverables. The ideal candidate is someone who is extremely organized, communicates clearly, follows through consistently, and naturally takes ownership of making sure things get done.



What You'll Do



- Support Service Managers with day-to-day client account management, including preparing for client meetings, providing project updates, tracking outstanding items, and keeping them informed of project status.

- Coordinate client and internal meetings, including scheduling, calendar coordination, confirmations, reminders, meeting notes, and follow-up communications.

- Manage and monitor tasks across multiple client projects, including creating, assigning, updating, and maintaining clear instructions, deadlines, and relevant information in the project management system.

- Follow up with clients and internal team members on outstanding requests, approvals, information, access, content, tasks, and deliverables to keep projects moving forward.

- Track project deadlines and deliverables, proactively identifying overdue or at-risk tasks, potential bottlenecks, and other issues, and communicating them to the Service Manager.

- Coordinate work across internal teams, including SEO, web development, content, paid advertising, design, and other departments, ensuring tasks and deliverables are properly assigned and completed.

- Maintain accurate project documentation, including task updates, client requests, meeting notes, revisions, approvals, and action items, ensuring important information is communicated to the appropriate team members.

- Prepare project updates, reports, and meeting materials as needed to support Service Managers and client communications.

- Take ownership of follow-through, ensuring commitments, action items, and deliverables are completed and that nothing falls through the cracks



What We're Looking For



The ideal candidate is someone who is organized, proactive, dependable, and excellent at follow-through.



- 4+ years of experience in account management, project coordination, project management, or a similar role.

- Strong written and verbal communication skills.

- Excellent organization and time-management skills.

- Ability to manage multiple clients and projects simultaneously.

- Strong attention to detail.

- Comfortable following up with both clients and internal team members.

- Ability to prioritize competing deadlines.

- Strong follow-through and accountability.

- Comfortable working with project management and communication tools.

- Ability to identify potential problems before they become larger issues.

- Ability to work independently without requiring constant direction.

- Professional and confident communication style.

- Experience in a digital marketing agency is strongly preferred.



Familiarity with the following is a plus:



- SEO

- Local SEO / Google Business Profile

- Website development

- Content marketing

- Google Ads / PPC

- Social media marketing

-
 marketing

- Analytics and reporting

- Conversion rate optimization



You do not need to be an expert in every area of digital marketing. However, you should be comfortable working alongside marketing specialists and understanding the general workflow of a digital marketing agency.



The Type of Person Who Will Succeed Here



We're looking for someone who:



- Naturally follows up on outstanding items.

- Is extremely organized and detail-oriented.

- Keeps projects moving without constant supervision.

- Communicates proactively when something is delayed or unclear.

- Is comfortable sending follow-up
s and making sure people respond.

- Can manage multiple deadlines without becoming overwhelmed.

- Takes ownership of administrative and project-related responsibilities.

- Understands that creating a task isn't the same as making sure the task gets completed.

- Is dependable and consistent.

- Can work effectively with both clients and internal team members.

- Is comfortable supporting Service Managers and helping them stay organized.

- Doesn't let things fall through the cracks.



What Success Looks Like



Success in this role means our Service Managers can rely on you to help keep their accounts organized and moving forward. You will be successful when:



- Meetings are scheduled on time.

- Follow-up
s are sent without being prompted.

- Client requests are properly documented and tracked.

- Internal team members are followed up with consistently.

- Tasks have clear deadlines and ownership.

- Service Managers always know the status of their projects.

- Clients receive timely updates.

- Potential delays are identified before they become problems.

- Nothing important gets lost or forgotten.

- Projects continue moving forward without the Service Manager having to personally chase every detail.



Why Join The Ad Firm?



At The Ad Firm, you'll have the opportunity to make a real impact, develop your skills, and grow with a company that is continuing to expand. You'll work alongside experienced professionals across multiple areas of digital marketing and gain exposure to a wide range of clients, industries, and projects.



We value people who take initiative, solve problems, and take ownership of their work. We want our team members to have the freedom to contribute ideas, the support to develop professionally, and the opportunity to take on greater responsibility as they grow.



We're building a team where people can do meaningful work, learn from one another, and be recognized for the value they bring. If you're organized, proactive, driven, and looking for an opportunity to grow your career in digital marketing, The Ad Firm is a place where you can build something—not just fill a position.



What We Offer
